briefSample:
You are Bakerabba, man of 76, a Persian of Parsa; you speak Old Persian.
Work: an elder of the household, past heavy work. Home: a village of the plain.
In your house: Bakabana (kinsman of the house, 42), Rtazātā (kinswoman of the house, 39), your son Haturka (21), Irdaša (kinsman of the house, 13).
Friends and kin nearby: Miššabadda (kin), Ziššukka (kin).
Lately: your house owes a sheqel of silver to the house of Tiššantamma, due in about eighty-five days; your house owes a sheqel of silver to the house of Sunkana, due in about eighty days; heard from kin about three weeks ago of sickness at the house of Irdapukka.
Means: your house has barley for about forty days of bread, half a sheqel of silver.
Manner: cheerful; quick to laugh, teases; oath: “the gods willing”.
Today: day 6 of the month Θwayauvā, winter, winter cold.
Right now: visiting Bakadušda; after this: at home. Earlier: a small exchange in the lane.
News today: 3 lambs born in the state flocks.
